blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Jev is a commercial “System One” model from TypeSafe AI that does not generate text: given a state and typed questions, it returns a choice from fixed options, a position on a rubric, or the probability that a statement is true, with probabilities the vendor describes as calibrated. Such models target small decisions in information access pipelines, such as routing queries, checking grounding, moderating content, or rating against a rubric. We evaluate Jev ( jev-1.13.0 ) zero-shot on 37 datasets spanning classification, routing, natural language inference, reading comprehension, commonsense reasoning, moderation, legal clause analysis and rubric scoring, with one frozen template per dataset and full evaluation splits: 346,009 requests for under US$10. For reference, we score Qwen3.8-27B and Gemma-4-E4B on identical requests via their exact next-token probabilities over the options. Jev reaches 95–99% accuracy on IMDB, SST-2, HellaSwag and ARC and 86.7% on Belebele across 122 languages. It beats Qwen on 27 of 37 datasets, with none of Qwen’s nine leads outside the bootstrap intervals, and Gemma on all 37. All three models degrade on low-resource languages, fine-grained or noisy labels, and rubric-based quality judgments. Jev’s choice probabilities are well calibrated and support selective prediction. Binary probabilities rank well but are poorly placed relative to a fixed 0.5 threshold; thresholds tuned on training data raise micro-F 1 {}_{\text{1}} on UNFAIR-ToS from 0.50 to 0.75. Jev answers MMLU’s calculation-heavy questions more accurately than other MMLU questions (94% vs. 91%), whereas both open models, and all three on C-Eval, find them harder. Rotating the options leaves Jev’s accuracy unchanged and withholding the question drops it to near chance, ruling out shallow memorization but not memorized question-answer pairs. We release the code, harness and all raw responses.
blocks.zh: Jev是一个来自TypeSafe AI的商用“系统一”模型,不生成文本:由于一个状态和打出的问题,它从固定选项中返回一个选择,在标题上的位置,或者一个声明是真实的概率,供应商描述为校准概率. 这种模式针对信息获取管道中的小决定,如路由查询、检查地面、调制内容或按标题评级。 我们评价37个数据集的Jev(jev-1.13.0)零镜头,包括分类、路由、自然语言推论、阅读理解、常识推理、温和、法律条款分析和记号分数,每个数据集有一个冻结模板,全部评价分数:346 009项10美元以下的请求。 参考一下,我们得分是 Qune3.8-27B 和 Gemma-4-E4B 在相同的请求上,通过他们 准确的下接概率 选择。 Jev在IMDB,SST-2,HelaSwag和ARC的精度达到95–99%,在Belebele的精度达到86.7%,使用122种语言. 它在37个数据集的27个上击败了Quen,在靴子间隔之外没有Quen的9个线索,在全部37个上都击败了Gemma. 所有三种模型都以低资源语言、细微的标签或吵闹的标签以及基于文字的质量判断而退化。 Jev的选择概率被很好地校准和支持选择性预测. 二进制概率排名良好,但与固定的0.5阈值相比位置差;以培训数据为调制的阈值将微F 1 QQText{1}}在UNFAIR-TOS上从0.50提高到0.75。 Jev比其他MMLU问题(94%对91%)更准确地回答MMLU的计算重问题,而开放模型和C-Eval上的所有三个模型都更难找到。 改变选项让Jev的准确性保持不变, 我们发布了代码, 绳索和所有原始反应。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used not to write text but to make small, well-scoped decisions inside software and information access systems, such as routing a support request or a query to the right handler [ 1 ] , flagging a harmful message [ 2 ] , checking whether a claim is supported by a retrieved document [ 3 ] , finding contradictions in written text [ 4 ] , or rating a response against a rubric [ 5 ] . Using a generative/autoregressive model for such decisions is quite indirect. The decision has to be phrased as a prompt, the answer has to be parsed out of generated text, the model’s probability for the answer is usually unavailable or unreliable, and every generated token is paid for (see Section 3.6 for such an implementation).
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)越来越多地被用来不写文字,而是在软件和信息访问系统内部作出范围很广的小型决定,例如向右手处理器发送支持请求或查询[1],标出有害信息[2],检查索赔是否得到检索到的文件[3]的支持,在书面文本中发现矛盾[4],或对一个标题[5]作出响应. 使用基因/自动递减模式作出这种决定是相当间接的。 决定必须用一个即时词来表达,答案必须用生成的文本来解析,模型的答案概率通常不可用或不可靠,并且每个生成的令牌都得到支付(这样的执行见第3.6节).

blocks.en: TypeSafe AI’s Jev [ 6 ] takes a different route. Borrowing the distinction between fast, intuitive “System 1” and slow, deliberate “System 2” thinking [ 7 ] , it is marketed as a System One model : it never generates text but answers typed questions about a given state with structured outputs, namely a choice from a set of options, a score on an ordered rubric, or the probability that a statement is true. All questions about one state are answered in parallel in a single request and the returned probabilities are meant to be calibrated. TypeSafe AI documents example use cases and a list of known failure modes in their documentation 1 1 1 docs.typesafe.ai/model-jaggedness/jev-1.13 , accessed 2026-09-29. but, to our knowledge and at the time of writing, no systematic evaluation on public benchmarks exists.
blocks.zh: TypeSafe AI的Jev [6] 采用不同的路线. 它借用了快速、直观的“系统1”和缓慢、刻意的“系统2”的思维[7]之间的区别,作为“系统1”模式加以销售:它从不产生文字,而是对有结构输出的某个特定状态的回答,即从一组选项中作出选择,在定点标题上得分,或者说一个语句是真实的概率。 所有关于一个国家的问题都同时在一个请求中解答,返回的概率是用来校准的. TypeSafe AI文档在文档中使用案例和已知故障模式列表 1 1 1 docs.typesafe.ai/model-jiggness/jev-1.13,访问2026-09-29。 但据我们所知,在编写本报告时,还没有对公共基准进行系统评价。

blocks.en: This paper provides such an evaluation together with the resources needed to reuse it. Our contributions are: • A benchmark suite of 37 public datasets mapped onto Jev’s three question primitives, covering seven task families and over 200 language varieties, with one frozen template per dataset. • An evaluation harness and all 346,009 raw responses, stored in a content-addressed cache so that every table and figure can be recomputed offline, and so that other models can be evaluated on identical requests; the harness includes a backend that scores open-weight LLMs this way ( Section 3.7 ). • A zero-shot evaluation on the full evaluation splits (346,009 requests), reporting task performance with bootstrap confidence intervals, calibration, selective prediction and cost. • A comparison with two open-weight LLMs, Qwen3.8-27B and Gemma-4-E4B, scored on identical requests through their exact option probabilities, which puts Jev’s accuracy and calibration in context and serves as a control for its MMLU result. • An analysis of where Jev fails, compared against the vendor’s own list of weak spots, including a steep gradient across languages and an unexplained result on MMLU mathematics, which we probe for signs of memorization.
blocks.zh: 本文件提供了这种评价以及重新使用所需的资源。 我们的贡献是: 由37个公共数据集组成的基准套件绘制在Jev的三个问题原始本上,涵盖七个任务家庭和200多个语言品种,每个数据集有一个冻结的模板。 使用一个评价装置和所有346 009个原始答复,储存在一个内容地址的缓存中,以便每个表格和数字可以重新计算出下线,并能够根据相同的请求评价其他模型;这种装置包括一个后端,以这种方式对开量的LLMs进行评分(第3.7节)。 • 报告任务执行情况,并有轨电车置信间隔、校准、选择性预测和成本。 与两个开放重量级的LLM(Qune3.8-27B)和Gemma-4-E4B(Gemma-4-E4B)相比,它们通过其确切的选项概率在相同的请求中得分,这使Jev的精确度和校准度符合上下文,并成为对其MMLU结果的控制。 分析Jev的失败地点, 与销售商自己的弱点列表相比,

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Zero-shot classification with pretrained models
blocks.zh: 2.1 采用预先训练过的型号的零镜头分类

blocks.en: Framing classification as natural language inference [ 8 ] and prompting generative LLMs [ 9 ] made it possible to solve many classification and multiple-choice tasks without task-specific training, a setting known as “zero-shot”. Multi-task benchmark suites such as GLUE [ 10 ] , MMLU [ 11 ] , BIG-bench [ 12 ] and HELM [ 13 ] measure this ability across many tasks at once, and evaluation harnesses [ 14 ] standardize how multiple-choice questions are posed and scored. Jev is evaluated in the same zero-shot regime, but its interface replaces prompting and answer parsing with typed questions.
blocks.zh: 将分类作为自然语言推论[8],并促使遗传性LLMS[9],使得在没有具体任务训练的情况下解决许多分类和多选择任务成为可能,这种设置被称为"零射". 多任务基准套件,如GLUE [10],MMLU [11],BIG-bench [12]和HELM [13]一次衡量许多任务中的这种能力,评价利用[14] 如何提出和评分多个选择问题实现标准化. Jev在相同的零射法体系中被评价,但其界面取代了提示和解析,以打字的问题进行解析.

blocks.en: 2.2 Calibration and selective prediction
blocks.zh: 2.2 校准和选择性预测

blocks.en:
Modern neural networks are often miscalibrated [ 15 ] , which also holds for many LLMs: while pretrained language models can be reasonably well calibrated [ 16 ] , instruction tuning and RLHF tend to degrade calibration [ 17 , 18 ] .
For such a calibration, the expected calibration error (ECE) [ 19 ] and the Brier score [ 20 ] are standard summaries of calibration. Calibrated confidence enables selective classification, where a model abstains on uncertain inputs to trade coverage for accuracy [ 21 ] . Jev exposes probabilities and a confidence score for every answer, which makes both properties directly measurable.
blocks.zh:
现代神经网络往往被错误校准[15],这也为许多LLMs所持有:虽然预训语言模型可以合理校准[16],但指令调制和RLHF倾向于降解校准[17,18].
对于这样的校准,预期校准误差(ECE)[19]和布赖尔分数[20]是校准的标准总结. 校准信心可以进行有选择的分类,在这种分类中,一个模型对贸易覆盖面的准确性不采用不确定的投入[21]。 Jev对每个回答都暴露概率和信心分数,这使得两个属性都直接可以测量.

blocks.en: 2.3 LLMs as judges
blocks.zh: 2.3 担任法官的法学硕士

blocks.en: LLMs are increasingly used to label and rate content, from relevance judgments for retrieval evaluation [ 22 , 23 ] to summary quality on SummEval [ 24 , 25 ] and response helpfulness [ 26 ] . Jev’s Score primitive is designed for this kind of rubric-based judgment.
blocks.zh: LLMs越来越多地用于标签和评分内容,从用于检索评价的相关判断[22,23]到SummEval[24,25]上的简要质量和反应帮助[26]. 贾夫 积分原始是设计为这种基于微调的判断.

blocks.en: 2.4 Contamination
blocks.zh: 2.4 污染

blocks.en: Public benchmarks may have leaked into the training data of the models evaluated on them, which inflates reported performance [ 27 ] . Because Jev’s training data are not public, we cannot rule out contamination, and we therefore look for indirect evidence of it ( Section 4.6 ).
blocks.zh: 公共基准可能泄露到对其评价的模型的培训数据中,从而夸大了业绩[27]。 由于Jev的训练数据不公开,我们不能排除污染,因此我们寻找间接证据(第4.6节)。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Jev and its question primitives
blocks.zh: 3.1 Jev及其问题原始人

blocks.en: A Jev request consists of a state (a string or a JSON object or array) and a map of named questions [ 6 ] . Each question is one of three primitives: • Choice selects one option from up to 255 options, each given as a key with an optional description. It returns the selected option, a probability for every option, and a confidence value derived from that distribution. • Score places the state on an ordered rubric of 2 to 10 described levels. It returns the probability of each level, the probability-weighted level (the score ) and a confidence value. • Noul asks a yes/no question and returns the probability that the answer is yes. All questions in a request share the state but are answered independently. Instructions and state fields can be linked by referring to a field name in backticks. We pinned the model version jev-1.13.0 for all requests. At the time of writing, Jev is priced at US$0.042 per million input tokens (output tokens are free) and accepts up to 32k tokens for the state plus the longest question.
blocks.zh: A级 Jev请求由状态(字符串或JSON对象或阵列)和命名问题地图[6]组成. 每个问题都是三个原始问题之一: • 选择从最多255个选项中选择一个选项,每个选项作为带有可选描述的密钥给出. 它返回所选的选项,每个选项的概率,以及从该分布中得出的信任值. • 支助 得分将状态置于2到10级的指令面上。 它返回每个关卡的概率,概率加权的关卡(分数)和信心值. • 支助 努尔提出一个是/否的问题,并返回答案是是的概率. 请求中的所有问题都共享状态,但得到独立回答。 指令和状态字段可以通过在 backticks 中引用一个字段名称来链接. 我们对所有请求都进行了测试 在撰写时,Jev的定价为每百万个输入令牌0.042美元(输出令牌是免费的),并且接受最多32k的令牌作为该州加最长的问题.

blocks.en: 3.2 Benchmark suite
blocks.zh: 3.2 基准套件

blocks.en: Table 1 lists the 37 datasets we evaluate Jev on. We started from a list of commonly used classification and multiple-choice datasets and extended it so that (i) all three primitives are exercised, including multi-question requests, (ii) the use cases Jev is marketed for (routing, guardrails, grounding checks, rubric scoring) are covered, and (iii) the datasets are small enough to be evaluated in full. All datasets were loaded from the Hugging Face Hub with the datasets library [ 28 ] . We made the following adjustments: • Where test labels are not public (SST-2, HellaSwag, WinoGrande, CommonsenseQA, α \alpha NLI, BoolQ), we evaluate on the validation split. SMS Spam, the OpenAI moderation set and PubMedQA’s 1,000 expert-labeled questions are evaluated in full. • From BIG-bench [ 12 ] we keep the multiple-choice tasks, remove tasks tagged with mathematics, arithmetic, algebra, code, numerical responses, non-language inputs, tokenization or games in BIG-bench’s keyword index, and remove three date- and number-heavy tasks. This follows TypeSafe AI’s own advice to keep arithmetic in code [ 6 ] . The result is 93 tasks, capped at 500 examples each (13,228 examples). • One SIB-200 configuration entry ( nqo_Nkoo.zip , a broken duplicate of the N’Ko configuration) cannot be loaded from Hugging Face and is skipped.

blocks.en: 3.3 Request construction
blocks.zh: 3.3 请求建造

blocks.en: Every example in each dataset becomes exactly one request (identical examples yield identical requests, which are sent only once; see Table 7 ). The example’s fields form a JSON state with descriptive names (e.g. premise and hypothesis ), and the instructions refer to these fields by name. We map tasks onto primitives as follows: • Classification uses a Choice whose options are the dataset’s labels, with one-sentence descriptions where a label name alone is ambiguous (e.g. for AG News [ 29 ] topics or NLI relations). CLINC150 additionally has an explicit out-of-scope option. • Multiple-choice questions use a Choice whose options are the answer candidates, keyed A, B, C, … (or AA, AB, … beyond 26 options). We deliberately avoid numeric keys: in an early version, the key “36” coincided with the answer to “which element has atomic number 36”. • Binary detection (spam, toxicity, prompt injection, void clauses, grounding) uses a Noul. • Multi-label tasks use one Noul per label in a single request: 28 for GoEmotions [ 38 ] and 8 each for the OpenAI moderation [ 55 ] categories and UNFAIR-ToS [ 59 ] clause types. Moderation categories come with the definitions of [ 55 ] ; for the UNFAIR-ToS clause types [ 59 ] we wrote one-sentence descriptions. • Ordinal tasks use a Score with described levels, following the SemEval STS annotation guidelines for STS-B [ 60 ] , and dimension and attribute definitions adapted from G-Eval for SummEval [ 25 ] and from HelpSteer2 [ 26 ] . ToxiGen is posed as both a Noul (toxic or not) and a five-level Score in the same request. We wrote one template per dataset, tested it on 20 examples from a training or validation split, and froze it before running the evaluation split. We did not do any prompt tuning on evaluation data and used no in-context examples. Figure 1 shows an example request.
blocks.zh: 每个数据集中的每一例都完全是一个请求(相同的例子产生相同的请求,只发出一次;见表7)。 例子的字段组成了带有描述性名称的JSON状态(如前提和假说),而说明则以名字指代这些字段. 我们把任务映射到原始人身上如下: • 分类使用选择,其选项是数据集的标签,如果一个标签名称是模糊的(例如AG News[29]主题或NLI关系),则使用一刑描述. CLINC150还具有明确的范围外选项. · 多重选择问题使用一个选择,其选项为答案候选人,按键为A、B、C.(或AA、AB,......超过26个选项)。 我们故意避免数字键:在早期版本中,“36”键与“哪个元素的原子编号为36”的答案相吻合。 • 二进制检测(垃圾、毒性、迅速注射、无效条款、搁浅)使用努尔语。 · 多标签任务在一次请求中每个标签使用一个努尔语:28用于Gemotions[38],8用于OpenAI温和度[55]类别和UNFAIR-TOS[59]条款类型。 温和类别与[55]的定义一致;对于UNFAIR-TOS条款类型[59],我们写了一个判决说明。 • 标准任务使用一个有说明等级的分数,遵循STS-B[60]的SemEval STS注释准则,以及从G-Eval为SummEval[25]和HelpSteer2[26]改编的尺寸和属性定义。 ToxiGen在同一个请求中既被作为努尔语(有毒与否),又被作为五级分数. 我们每个数据集都写了一个模板,测试了20个从培训或验证拆分出来的例子,并在进行评价拆分之前将其冻结。 我们没有及时调整评价数据,也没有使用文字中的例子。 图1显示一个实例请求。

blocks.en: Classification uses a Choice whose options are the dataset’s labels, with one-sentence descriptions where a label name alone is ambiguous (e.g. for AG News [ 29 ] topics or NLI relations). CLINC150 additionally has an explicit out-of-scope option.
blocks.zh: 分类使用一个选择,其选项是数据集的标签,如果一个标签名称单是模糊不清的,则使用一个一刑描述(例如AG News[29]主题或NLI关系)。 CLINC150还具有明确的范围外选项.

blocks.en: Multiple-choice questions use a Choice whose options are the answer candidates, keyed A, B, C, … (or AA, AB, … beyond 26 options). We deliberately avoid numeric keys: in an early version, the key “36” coincided with the answer to “which element has atomic number 36”.
blocks.zh: 多选择问题使用一个选择,其选项是答案候选人,键为A,B,C,......(或AA,AB,......超过26个选项). 我们故意避免数字键:在早期版本中,“36”键与“哪个元素的原子编号为36”的答案相吻合。

blocks.en: Binary detection (spam, toxicity, prompt injection, void clauses, grounding) uses a Noul.
blocks.zh: 二进制检测(垃圾、毒性、即时注射、无效条款、搁浅)使用努尔。

blocks.en: Multi-label tasks use one Noul per label in a single request: 28 for GoEmotions [ 38 ] and 8 each for the OpenAI moderation [ 55 ] categories and UNFAIR-ToS [ 59 ] clause types. Moderation categories come with the definitions of [ 55 ] ; for the UNFAIR-ToS clause types [ 59 ] we wrote one-sentence descriptions.
blocks.zh: 多标签任务在单个请求中每个标签使用一个努尔:GoEmotions[38]和OpenAI节制[55]类别和UNFAIR-TOS[59]条款类型各8个. 温和类别与[55]的定义一致;对于UNFAIR-TOS条款类型[59],我们写了一个判决说明。

blocks.en: Ordinal tasks use a Score with described levels, following the SemEval STS annotation guidelines for STS-B [ 60 ] , and dimension and attribute definitions adapted from G-Eval for SummEval [ 25 ] and from HelpSteer2 [ 26 ] . ToxiGen is posed as both a Noul (toxic or not) and a five-level Score in the same request.
blocks.zh: 标准任务使用带有描述等级的分数,遵循STS-B [60] 的SemEval STS注释准则,以及从G-Eval为SummEval [25] 和HelpSteer 2 [26] 改编的尺寸和属性定义. ToxiGen在同一个请求中既被作为努尔语(有毒与否),又被作为五级分数.

blocks.en: Figure 1: A ToxiGen request: one state and two questions (a Noul and a five-level Score), answered in parallel.
blocks.zh: 图1:托克西根请求:一个州和两个问题(一个努尔,一个五级得分),平行回答.

blocks.en: 3.4 Metrics
blocks.zh: 3.4 计量

blocks.en: For each dataset we report the metric customary for it as the primary metric: accuracy for most tasks; positive-class F 1 {}_{\text{1}} for imbalanced binary detection; macro-F 1 {}_{\text{1}} for GoEmotions [ 38 ] ; micro-F 1 {}_{\text{1}} for UNFAIR-ToS, following LexGLUE [ 59 ] ; mean AUPRC over categories for the OpenAI moderation set [ 55 ] ; the mean of per-source balanced accuracies for LLM-AggreFact [ 3 ] ; and Spearman correlation for Score tasks, computed per source document and then averaged for SummEval (“summary-level”, as in G-Eval [ 25 ] ). Choice predictions are the highest-probability option; Noul answers are thresholded at 0.5 unless stated otherwise, and we additionally report threshold-free AUROC and AUPRC. For four datasets we also report per-question thresholds chosen to maximize F 1 {}_{\text{1}} on 1,000 examples from a training or validation split (grid step 0.01) and applied unchanged to the evaluation split ( Section 4.3 ).
blocks.zh: 对于每个数据集,我们报告其习惯的衡量标准为主要衡量标准:大多数任务的准确性;不平衡的二进制检测的正数级F 1 QQText{1};GoEmotions [38]的宏F 1 QQText{1};UNFAIR-TOS的微F 1 QQText{1},遵循LexGLUE [59];OpenAI温和量组的AUPRC 大于类别[55];LLM-AggreFact [3]的源平衡速率平均值;以及Spearman 相关分数任务,按源文件计算,然后按总分数计算(“摘要级”,如G-Eval [25])。 选择预测是最高概率的选项;除非另有说明,努尔答案的阈值为0.5,我们另外报告无阈值的AUROC和AUPRC. 对于四个数据集,我们还报告从培训或验证拆分(grid step 0.01)中为尽量扩大F 1 QQText{1}})而选择的每个问题阈值,并对评价拆分(第4.3节)适用不变。

blocks.en: Calibration is measured with the ECE over 15 equal-width bins [ 19 ] , using the top-option probability for Choices and P ⁡ ( yes ) P(\text{yes}) for Nouls, and with the Brier score [ 20 ] . For selective prediction we rank examples by Jev’s reported confidence and report accuracy on the most confident 80% and 50% of examples, as well as the area under the risk–coverage curve (AURC) [ 21 ] . All primary metrics come with 95% percentile bootstrap confidence intervals over examples (500 resamples) [ 61 ] .
blocks.zh: 校准是用欧洲经委会的15个等宽箱计量的[19],使用选择和P +(是)P(\text{yes})的首选概率对Nouls进行校准,并使用Brier得分[20]。 对于有选择性的预测,我们用Jev报告的信心来排列实例,并报告最有信心的80%和50%实例的准确性,以及风险覆盖曲线(AURC)下的区域[21]。 所有主要的度量标准都包含95%的靴子置信间隔(500个复标)[61]。

blocks.en: 3.5 Execution
blocks.zh: 3.5 执行

blocks.en: Requests were sent with an asynchronous client at up to 1,100 requests per minute with 32 concurrent connections from a single machine. The full evaluation took 5 h 15 min. Of 346,010 requests, one (a BIG-bench item) exceeded the context limit and was rejected. All others were answered.
blocks.zh: 请求由一个同步客户端发送,每分钟最多1 100个请求,同时有32个单一机连接。 全面评价用了5小时15分钟。 在346 010项请求中,1项(BIG-bench项目)超过上下文限制,被驳回。 其他人都得到了答复。

blocks.en: 3.6 Open-weight reference models
blocks.zh: 3.6 开放式参考模型

blocks.en: To put Jev’s numbers in context, we score two instruction-tuned open-weight LLMs on exactly the same requests: Qwen3.8-27B [ 62 ] (27.8B parameters) and Gemma-4-E4B [ 63 ] (8.0B parameters, about 4B effective). Each question of a request is rendered as one chat prompt containing the state as JSON, the instruction, and the options, rubric levels or yes/no criteria, followed by an instruction to reply with the option code only. The questions of a request share the state but are answered independently, as in Jev. Every answer option receives a code that is a single token in the model’s vocabulary: A, B, … (two-letter codes such as AA, AB beyond 26 options), Yes/No for Nouls and digits for Score levels; codes that a tokenizer splits into several tokens are skipped.
blocks.zh: 把Jev的数字放在上下文中,我们根据完全相同的要求获得两个指示调制的开量LLM:Qune3.8-27B[62](27.8B参数)和Gemma-4-E4B[63](8.0B参数,约4B有效). 请求的每个问题都作为一个聊天提示给出,其中包含作为JSON的状态,指令,以及选项,路标级别或是/否标准,然后是只使用选项代码的回复指令. 请求中的问题与该国相同,但如在Jev中那样得到独立的回答。 每个答题选项都得到一个代码,该代码是模型词汇中唯一的一个符号:A,B,...(双字母代码,如AA,AB超过26个选项),是/否对努尔斯和数位积分级;一个标语符分割成几个符号的代码被跳过.

blocks.en: One forward pass then yields the model’s exact next-token distribution, which we restrict to the codes and renormalize, obtaining a probability for every option, just as Jev returns one. From these we derive the chosen option, the probability-weighted score of Score questions and, for comparability, a confidence value computed with the formula of Jev’s documentation, ( K ​ p max − 1 ) / ( K − 1 ) (K\,p_{\max}-1)/(K-1) for K K options. Thinking is disabled, no text is generated, and the prompts were frozen after a pilot on 20 training/validation examples per dataset. On the evaluation splits, the models place a median of 0.997 (Qwen) and 1.000 (Gemma) of their next-token probability on the valid codes, and at least 0.93 for 99% of questions, so the renormalization discards little.
blocks.zh: 一个前传就得出了模型的下一个精确的分布,我们仅限于代码,并重新正常化,获得每个选项的概率,就像Jev返回一个选项一样。 从中我们得出了所选择的选项,即积分问题的概率加权分数,为了可比性,用Jev的文档公式计算出一个信心值,(K p 最大 − 1) / (K − 1) (K\, p_{\max) 1/ (K-1) 对于 K 选项。 思考被禁用,没有生成文本,每个数据集在20个训练/验证实例的实验后,提示被冻结. 在评价拆分时,模型在有效代码上放置了0.997(Quen)和1.000(Gemma)的下位概率中位数,99%的问题上至少放置了0.93,因此重归正态会很少丢弃.

blocks.en: We used Hugging Face transformers [ 64 ] in bf16 on a GPU cluster, with Gemma on NVIDIA A40 GPUs and Qwen on NVIDIA A100 80 GB GPUs. Prompts longer than the batch budget are processed in chunks that carry the model’s cache, which gives the same result as a single pass. Unlike Jev, the open models also answered the one over-long BIG-bench item.
blocks.zh: 我们使用hugging Face变压器 [64] in bf16在一个GPU集群上,Gemma在NVIDIA A40 GPU上,Quen在NVIDIA A100 80 GB GPU上. 超过批量预算的提示是用带模型缓存的块处理的,结果与单次通过相同。 与Jev不同,开放型号也回答了一个超长的BIG-bench项目.

blocks.en: 3.7 Publication of code & responses
blocks.zh: 3.7 公布守则和答复

blocks.en: Our repository, available at github.com/AppliedMachineLearning-Lab/jev-benchmarking , contains:
blocks.zh: 我们的储存库可在github.com/AppliedMachineLearning-Lab/jev-基准标记中找到,其中包含:

blocks.en: 1. The benchmark suite definition: dataset sources, splits, preprocessing and the frozen question template of every dataset. 2. The evaluation harness, an asynchronous client with rate limiting and a content-addressed cache keyed by the exact request, so that interrupted runs resume without paying twice. 3. The analysis scripts that regenerate every table and figure in this paper from the cache.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 基准套件定义:数据集源,拆分,预处理和每个数据集的冻结问题模板. 2. 评价工具是一个同步的客户端,费率受限,并按确切请求键定了内容地址的缓存,因此中断运行,不支付两次费用。 3. 从缓存中重新生成本文中每个表格和图的分析脚本.

blocks.en: The benchmark suite definition: dataset sources, splits, preprocessing and the frozen question template of every dataset.
blocks.zh: 基准套件定义:数据集源,拆分,预处理和每个数据集的冻结问题模板.

blocks.en: The evaluation harness, an asynchronous client with rate limiting and a content-addressed cache keyed by the exact request, so that interrupted runs resume without paying twice.
blocks.zh: 评估工具是一个同步的客户端,其费率受限制,并按确切要求键定了内容地址的缓存,因此中断运行时不支付两次。

blocks.en: The analysis scripts that regenerate every table and figure in this paper from the cache.
blocks.zh: 分析脚本从缓存中重新生成本文中的每一个表格和图.

blocks.en: We furthermore publish all responses of the three models on Zenodo, available at the DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23039006 . This makes three kinds of follow-up available to other researchers: recomputing or extending the analysis (for example other calibration metrics, per-language breakdowns, or thresholds tuned on training data); comparing other models against Jev on identical requests and templates, for which the harness provides a backend for open-weight LLMs ( Section 3.6 ); and tracking Jev across versions, since the pinned jev-1.13.0 responses serve as a fixed reference.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们还公布Zenodo上三种模型的所有答复,这些答复可在DOI 10.5281/zenodo 23039006上查阅。 这使其他研究人员可采用三种后续措施:重算或扩展分析(例如,其他校准度量表、按语种细分或以培训数据为主的阈值);在相同的请求和模板上将其他模型与Jev进行比较,为此,这一工具为开放重量的LLMs提供了后端(第3.6节);以及跟踪Jev各版本,因为被钉住的Jev-1.13.0答复是固定的参考。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Overall results
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 总结果

blocks.en: Table 2: Main results on the evaluation splits. Score: primary metric (see text); 95% bootstrap confidence interval; ECE of the first Choice or Noul question (– for Score-only tasks).
blocks.zh: 表2:评价的主要结果分为两部分。 得分:主要度量衡(见文本);95%的靴子置信间隔;第一个选择或努尔问题的欧洲经委会(-只为得分任务)。

blocks.en: Table 2 summarizes our overall results. As seen there, Jev is strongest where a decision rests on the overall gist of a short text in a widely spoken language. Binary sentiment (IMDB 96.5%, SST-2 96.4%, Rotten Tomatoes 93.3%), language identification (99.6%), commonsense multiple choice (HellaSwag 95.5%, WinoGrande 91.4%, CommonsenseQA 88.2%), science questions (ARC-Easy 99.3%, ARC-Challenge 97.7%) and passage-based yes/no questions (BoolQ 91.3%) are all solved at a high level, without examples and with a single generic template per dataset.
blocks.zh: 表2概述了我们的总体结果。 正如这里所看到的那样,Jev最强烈的是,决定取决于用广泛语言写成的短文的总体要点。 二进制情绪(IMDB96.5%,SST-296.4%,罗腾番茄93.3%),语言识别(99.6%),常识多重选择(HellaSwag95.5%,WinoGrande91.4%,CommonsenseQA88.2%),科学问题(ARC-Easy99.3%,ARC-Challenge97.7%)和基于通道的"是/否"问题(BoolQ91.3%)都是在高层次解决的,没有实例,每个数据集都有一个单一的通用模板.

blocks.en: 4.1.1 Routing

On intent routing, Jev reaches 89.5% on CLINC150 with 151 options in a single Choice and 79.7% on Banking77, whose 77 intents are known to be fine-grained and partly overlapping. On CLINC150, in-scope accuracy is 92.1%, and the explicit out-of-scope option recovers 77.6% of out-of-scope requests at a precision of 94.1%.
blocks.zh: 在意向路线方面,Jev在CLINC150上达到89.5%,单项选择有151个选项,银行77上达到79.7%,据了解,银行77个意向有细微差别,部分重叠. 在CLINC150上,内镜精度为92.1%,明确外镜选项以94.1%的精度回收77.6%的外镜请求.

blocks.en: 4.1.2 Inference and grounding
blocks.zh: 4.1.2 推论和依据

blocks.en: On ANLI, accuracy falls from 81.4% (round 1) to 74.0% (round 2) and 67.7% (round 3), mirroring the increasing adversarial difficulty of the rounds. PAWS paraphrase detection reaches 85.0%. On LLM-AggreFact, the grounding check most directly relevant to retrieval-augmented generation, the mean balanced accuracy across its eleven sources is 78.6%, ranging from 59.8% (ExpertQA) to 90.6% (Reveal).
blocks.zh: 在ANLI中,精度从81.4%(第1轮)下降到74.0%(第2轮)和67.7%(第3轮),这反映了各轮对抗性难度越来越大. PAWS 参数检测达到85.0%. 在LLM-AggreFact上,地面检查最直接与回收-增强生成有关,其11个来源的平均平衡准确度为78.6%,从59.8%(专家QA)到90.6%(Reveal)不等。

blocks.en: 4.1.3 Moderation and legal text
blocks.zh: 4.1.3 调解和法律文本

blocks.en: Jev ranks harmful content well: AUROC is 0.949 on ToxiGen, 0.989 (toxicity) and 0.994 (jailbreaking) on ToxicChat, and 0.972 on average across the eight OpenAI moderation categories. The per-category AUPRC ranges from 0.93 (sexual) and 0.91 (self-harm) down to 0.53 (harassment). The fixed 0.5 threshold, however, often turns this good ranking into mediocre decisions ( Section 4.3 ). Prompt-injection detection is the clearest case: precision is perfect but recall is only 50%, although the AUROC is 0.982. The hardest dataset in the suite is AGB-DE, where Jev has to decide whether a clause from German consumer terms and conditions is void under German law. With 4.9% positives, Jev reaches an F 1 {}_{\text{1}} of 0.204 and an AUROC of 0.784. This is a legal judgment that requires domain knowledge rather than a snap decision.
blocks.zh: Jev的有害含量排名良好:AUROC在ToxiGen上为0.949,在ToxiChat上为0.989(毒性)和0.994(破伤风),在OpenAI温和的8个类别中平均为0.972。 每类AUPRC从0.93(性)和0.91(自伤害)到0.53(骚扰)不等. 然而,固定的0.5阈值往往将这种良好的排名转化为平庸的决定(第4.3节)。 快速注射检测是最清楚的案例:精度是完美的,但召回率只有50%,尽管AUROC是0.982. 套件中最难的数据集是AGB-DE,Jev必须在此决定德国消费者条款和条件的条款根据德国法律是否无效. 阳性为4.9%,Jev达到F 1 QQText{1}0.204,AUROC为0.784. 这是一项法律判决,需要的是领域知识,而不是一时决定。

blocks.en: 4.1.4 Weak spots
blocks.zh: 4.1.4 国家 弱点

blocks.en: The lowest accuracies occur on Emotion (58.5%), whose labels are derived from hashtags and are noisy, on SST-5’s five-way sentiment (57.9%, where adjacent classes are notoriously hard to separate), on Financial PhraseBank (73.0%) and on low-resource NLI (AfriXNLI 64.0%; Section 4.5 ). Within BIG-bench, accuracy ranges from 100% on several tasks (e.g. cause-and-effect) to 32.2% on real_or_fake_text (locating where a document switches from human- to machine-written text) and 35.0% on minute_mysteries_qa (solving short mystery stories), both of which need long inputs to be read closely or reasoned over in several steps, a regime TypeSafe AI explicitly flags as difficult [ 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 在情感(58.5%)和低资源NLI(AfriXNLI 64.0%;第4.5节)上,其标签来源于标签和吵闹,在SST-5的五行情绪(57.9%,相邻阶层很难分开)上,在金融术语银行(73.0%)上,在NLI(AfriXNLI 64.0%;第4.5节)上,增幅最低。 在BIG-bench中,精确度从几个任务(如因果)的100%到real_or_fake_text上的32.2%(在文件从人文文字切换到机器文字的地方)和分钟_mysteries_qa上的35.0%(解决短密的故事)不等,两者都需要长时间的投入才能在几个步骤中仔细阅读或推理,一个政权TypeSafe AI明确标出难度[6].

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparison with open-weight LLMs
blocks.zh: 4.2 与开放式有限责任公司比较

blocks.en: Table 3: Jev and the two open-weight reference models on identical requests: primary metric (best per dataset in bold) and ECE of the first Choice or Noul question (– for Score-only tasks).
blocks.zh: 表3:Jev和关于相同请求的两个开放式参考模型:主要指标(每个数据集以粗体表示最佳)和第一个选择或努尔问题的欧洲经委会(-只计分任务)。

blocks.en: Table 3 compares Jev with the two open-weight models on the primary metric of every dataset. Jev scores higher than Qwen3.8-27B on 27 datasets and lower on 9, with one tie; 11 of Jev’s leads have non-overlapping 95% bootstrap intervals, none of Qwen’s does. Jev’s largest margins over Qwen are on WinoGrande (+15.1 points), MMLU (+10.1), Belebele (+8.9) and BIG-bench (+6.4), and on AGB-DE (+20.4 points of F 1 {}_{\text{1}} ), where Qwen never predicts a void clause at the 0.5 threshold ( Table 4 ). Qwen’s leads are small, at most 1.2 points on six datasets, except on UNFAIR-ToS (+8.3), HelpSteer2 (+3.1) and the 116-example prompt-injection set (+2.6).
blocks.zh: 表3 比较 Jev 在每个数据集的主要度量衡上有两个开放量的模型. Jev在27个数据集中得分高于Qwen3.8-27B,在9个数据集中得分低于Qwen3.8-27B,只有1个平局;Jev的11个线索没有重叠95%的靴子间隔,没有一个Quen的间隔. Jev在Quen上的最大边幅是WinoGrande(+15.1分),MMLU(+10.1),Belebele(+8.9)和BIG-bench(+6.4),以及AGB-DE(+20.4分F 1 Qintext{1}}),Quen从未在0.5阈值上预测无效条款(表4). 除了UNFAIR-TOS(+8.3),HelpSteer2(+3.1)和116例的即时注射集(+2.6)之外,Quen的线索很小,最多在六个数据集上只有1.2分.

blocks.en: Gemma-4-E4B is below Jev on all 37 datasets, 31 of them with non-overlapping intervals; the gap is smallest on sentiment and language identification (1–2 points) and largest on ANLI, CLINC150, MMLU, WinoGrande and C-Eval (20–30 points). Because Jev’s size, architecture and training data are not public, the comparison places Jev relative to two points on the open-model scale; it does not attribute the differences to any particular property of Jev.
blocks.zh: Gemma-4-E4B在所有37个数据集中都低于Jev,其中31个数据集的间隔不重叠;在情绪和语言识别(1-2分)上差距最小,在ANLI,CLINC150,MMLU,WinoGrande和C-Eval(20–30分)上差距最大. 由于Jev的大小,架构和培训数据并不公开,因此比较将Jev相对于两个点放在开放模型尺度上;它没有将区别归属于Jev的任何特定属性.

blocks.en: 4.3 Calibration and selective prediction
blocks.zh: 4.3 校准和选择性预测

blocks.en: Figure 2: Pooled reliability diagrams for Jev and the two open-weight models (15 bins; marker area proportional to the number of answers). Left: top-option probability vs. accuracy for all Choice questions. Middle and right: P ⁡ ( yes ) P(\text{yes}) vs. the observed frequency of yes, for single Noul questions and for multi-label requests with one Noul per label.
blocks.zh: 图 2:Jev和两个开量模型的集合可靠性图(15个宾箱;与答案数成比例的标记区). 左键:所有选择问题的上选项概率与准确性。 中间和右边: P QQ( 是) P(\text{yes}) vs 观测到的频率为是,用于单个努尔问题和每个标签一个努尔的多标签请求.

blocks.en: On the topic of calibration, Figure 2 shows that Jev’s three kinds of probability behave differently, and how they compare with the probabilities of the open-weight models. Our observations here are:
blocks.zh: 关于校准问题,图2显示Jev的三种概率表现不同,以及它们如何与开放量模型的概率进行比较. 我们的观察是:

blocks.en: Choice probabilities are well calibrated. Pooled over 22 Choice datasets and 279,925 answers, the ECE is 0.028. Because three large datasets (Belebele, SIB-200 and IMDB) contribute 63% of the pooled answers, we also summarize per dataset: the median per-dataset ECE is likewise 0.028, while the unweighted mean is 0.061. The ECE is at most 0.03 for 11 of the 22 datasets and at most 0.05 for 14 ( Table 8 in the appendix). Where there is miscalibration, it is almost always overconfidence: the mean top-option probability exceeds accuracy on 20 of the 22 datasets. Miscalibration is concentrated on the datasets where accuracy is low (Spearman ρ = − 0.83 \rho=-0.83 between accuracy and ECE), with Emotion (ECE 0.279) and AfriXNLI (0.165) as the extremes. Qwen’s pooled Choice probabilities are less well calibrated (ECE 0.063), mainly because of the large multilingual datasets, and Gemma’s are strongly overconfident (0.208; mean top-option probability 0.936 at 72.8% accuracy). Averaged over the 33 datasets with a Choice or Noul question ( Table 3 ), Jev (0.074) and Qwen (0.075) are on par, and both are far better calibrated than Gemma (0.184).
blocks.zh: 选择概率的校准很好。 欧洲经委会汇集了22个选择数据集和279 925个答案,为0.028。 由于三个大数据集(Belebele,SIB-200和IMDB)贡献了集合答案的63%,我们还总结了每个数据集:每个数据集的中位数ECE同样为0.028,而未加权平均值为0.061. 在22个数据集中,欧洲经委会的11个数据集最多为0.03个,14个数据集最多为0.05个(附录表8)。 在存在校准错误的地方,它几乎总是过度自信:22个数据集中,平均上选项概率超过20个数据集的精确度. 校准错误集中在精度较低的数据集(Spearman ë = − 0.83\rho = -0.83在精度与ECE之间),以情感(ECE 0.279)和AfriXNLI(0.165)为极端. Quen的集合选择概率的校准程度较低(ECE 0.063),这主要是因为大型多语种数据集,而Gemma的高度过度自信(0.208;72.8%的精确度为0.936). 平均33个有选择或努尔问题的数据集(表3)、Jev(0.074)和Quen(0.075)处于平价状态,两者的校准都远优于Gemma(0.184)。

blocks.en: Single Noul probabilities are slightly under-confident. Over eight binary datasets, the mean predicted P ⁡ ( yes ) P(\text{yes}) is 0.465 against an observed yes-rate of 0.518, and the reliability curve lies above the diagonal (ECE 0.052). Positives therefore frequently receive probabilities below 0.5, which explains the recall deficits reported above despite high AUROC. The open models are further from calibrated here (ECE 0.113 for Qwen, whose mean P ⁡ ( yes ) P(\text{yes}) of 0.405 is even more under-confident, and 0.123 for Gemma).
blocks.zh: 单诺尔概率略低于信心. 超过八个二进制数据集,平均预测的PQQ(是)P(\text{yes})为0.465,而观测到的是率为0.518,可靠性曲线位于对角上方(ECE 0.052). 因此,积极因素往往得到的概率低于0.5,这解释了上述尽管阿拉伯团结和机会办事处存在很高的召回赤字。 开放型号从这里更进一步校准(Qwen的ECE 0.113,其0.405的P(\text{yes})的平均值为P QQ(是)P(\text{yes}),而Gemma的平均值为0.123).

blocks.en: Multi-label Noul probabilities over-predict yes. When many labels are queried at once, most of them rare, the mean P ⁡ ( yes ) P(\text{yes}) is 0.209 against an observed rate of 0.041 (ECE 0.168). Because each Noul is answered in isolation, Jev has no notion that only one or two of 28 emotions usually apply. Ranking remains good: the mean per-label AUROC is 0.873 on GoEmotions and 0.994 on UNFAIR-ToS. Threshold-based metrics, however, suffer (macro-F 1 {}_{\text{1}} 0.243 and micro-F 1 {}_{\text{1}} 0.499, respectively). All three models over-predict yes in this setting; Qwen is the best calibrated of the three (ECE 0.119, against 0.168 for Jev and 0.161 for Gemma).
blocks.zh: 多标签 Noul 概率超预测是的。 当许多标签同时被询问时,大多数是罕见的,平均P QQ(是) P(\text{yes})是0.209,而观测到的率为0.041(ECE 0168)。 由于每个努尔语都被孤立地回答,Jev完全不知道通常只有一两个情绪适用. 排名仍然不错:平均AUROC在GoEmotions上为0.873,在UNFAIR-TOS上为0.994。 然而,基于阈值的衡量标准(分别是宏观-F 1 QQText{1}0.243和微观-F 1 QQText{1}0.499)受到了影响。 所有三种型号都在此设置中超预计为是;Quen是三种型号中最好的校准(ECE 0.119,Jev为0.168,Gemma为0.161).

blocks.en: Table 4: F 1 {}_{\text{1}} with the fixed 0.5 threshold vs. per-question thresholds tuned on 1,000 training/validation examples and applied unchanged to the evaluation split, for each model (thresholds tuned on that model’s own answers).
blocks.zh: 表4:F 1 QQText{1},固定的0.5阈值与每个问题阈值相对应,以1,000个培训/验证实例为导向,对每个模型的评分适用不变(阈值以该模型自己的答案为准)。

blocks.en: Tuned thresholds recover much of the gap. The vendor describes thresholds as application-specific [ 6 ] . Table 4 shows what choosing them on training data achieves. For multi-label requests the gains are large: micro-F 1 {}_{\text{1}} rises from 0.499 to 0.748 on UNFAIR-ToS and macro-F 1 {}_{\text{1}} from 0.243 to 0.353 on GoEmotions. The tuned thresholds are mostly high (median 0.86 over the 28 GoEmotions labels), consistent with the over-prediction in Figure 2 . For ToxicChat, the jailbreak threshold rises to 0.85 and F 1 {}_{\text{1}} improves from 0.717 to 0.833, while toxicity barely changes. AGB-DE does not improve at all: 0.5 is already the best threshold on the training sample, so its low F 1 {}_{\text{1}} reflects weak separation of void and valid clauses (AUROC 0.784), not a misplaced threshold. Tuning helps the open models in the same way: Qwen’s micro-F 1 {}_{\text{1}} on UNFAIR-ToS rises from 0.582 to 0.757 and Gemma’s from 0.302 to 0.510. Tuned thresholds do not always transfer from 1,000 training examples, however: Qwen’s jailbreak F 1 {}_{\text{1}} drops slightly (0.743 to 0.726). On AGB-DE, Qwen predicts no void clause at 0.5 (F 1 {}_{\text{1}} 0.000) and reaches 0.179 with a tuned threshold.
blocks.zh: 固定阈值恢复了大部分差距。 供应商将阈值描述为具体应用[6]。 表4显示在培训数据方面选择这些课程的成果。 对于多标签请求,收益是巨大的:微F 1 QQText{1}}在UNFAIR-TOS上从0.499升至0.748,宏F 1 QQText{1}}在GoEmotion上从0.243升至0.353。 调制阈值大多很高(28个GoEmotions标签的中间值为0.86),与图2中的过度预测一致。 就毒瘾而言,越狱阈值上升到0.85,F 1 QQText{1}从0.717提高到0.833,而毒性几乎没有变化。 AGB-DE 完全没有改善 : 0.5已经是训练样本中最好的阈值,因此其较低的F 1 QQText{1}反映了无效和有效条款的微弱分离(AUROC 0.784),而不是错误的阈值. Tuning同样帮助开放型号: Quen的微F 1 QQText{1}在UNFAIR-TOS上从0.582升至0.757,Gemma的0.302升至0.510。 培训门槛并不总是从1 000个培训实例中转移,但是: Quen的越狱F 1 QQText{1}略有下降(0.743到0.726). 在AGB-DE上,Quen预测无无效条款为0.5(F 1 QQText{1}}0.000),并达到0.179的调值阈值.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Selective prediction: accuracy on the most confident fraction of examples (ranked by Jev’s confidence) as a function of coverage, for eight Choice datasets.
blocks.zh: 图3:选择性预测:作为覆盖功能,对8个选择数据集最自信的一小部分实例(以Jev的信心排序)的准确性.

blocks.en: Confidence is useful for routing decisions. Figure 3 shows that accuracy rises steadily as the least confident answers are withheld. At 50% coverage, accuracy increases from 79.7% to 96.3% on Banking77, from 81.5% to 98.2% on SIB-200, from 73.9% to 86.9% on ANLI and from 58.5% to 73.3% on Emotion. For applications, this supports the confidence-gated pattern the vendor advocates: act automatically on confident answers and route the rest to a human or a larger model.
blocks.zh: 信心对于路由决定是有用的。 图3显示,随着最不自信的答案被扣,准确性稳步上升。 在50%的覆盖率中,银行77的精度从79.7%提高到96.3%,SIB-200的精度从81.5%提高到98.2%,ANLI的精度从73.9%提高到86.9%,情感的精度从58.5%提高到73.3%。 对于应用程序,这支持供应商主张的自信模式:自动根据自信的答案采取行动,并将其余部分引向人型或更大型号。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Selective prediction for Jev and the two open-weight models on four datasets; each model’s answers are ranked by its own confidence.
blocks.zh: 图4:在四个数据集上对Jev和两个开放量级模型进行选择性预测;每个模型的答案按照自身的信心排序.

blocks.en: The open models’ confidence is informative as well ( Figure 4 ). At 50% coverage, Qwen reaches 94.5% on Banking77, 88.0% on ANLI, 97.6% on MMLU and 97.7% on Belebele, close to Jev’s 96.3%, 86.9%, 98.1% and 98.7%. Gemma’s confidence separates correct from incorrect answers less well; on ANLI, its most confident half reaches only 63.2%.
blocks.zh: 开放模式的信心也非常丰富(图4)。 在50%的覆盖率下,Quen在银行业达到94.5%,在ANLI达到88.0%,在MMLU达到97.6%,在Belebele达到97.7%,接近Jev的96.3%,86.9%,98.1%和98.7%。 Gemma的信心与错误的答案相左,

blocks.en: 4.4 Rubric scoring
blocks.zh: 4.4 鲁布里克评分

blocks.en: Table 5: Score questions: Spearman ρ \rho between each model’s probability-weighted score and the gold ratings (summary-level for SummEval; best in bold), and Jev’s mean absolute error in rubric levels.
blocks.zh: 表5:分数问题: Spearman ^\rho 在每个模型的概率加权得分和黄金分数之间(SummEval的汇总级;最好用粗体表示),以及Jev在数值级中的平均绝对误差.

blocks.en: Table 5 reports the Score results. When the rubric describes a property of the text itself, the probability-weighted score correlates strongly with human ratings: ρ = 0.890 \rho=0.890 for STS-B similarity, 0.851 for SST-5 sentiment and 0.841 for ToxiGen’s offensiveness ratings. Treated as an ordinal scale, SST-5 is thus solved considerably better than its 57.9% five-way accuracy suggests. Judging generated text is harder. On SummEval, the summary-level Spearman correlation averages 0.554 across the four dimensions, best for coherence (0.639) and worst for fluency (0.495, where Jev also rates systematically lower than the experts; MAE 1.77 levels). On HelpSteer2, correlations range from 0.275 (coherence) to 0.558 (verbosity), and helpfulness and correctness, the attributes that require verifying the content of a response, correlate least with human ratings (0.399 and 0.369). Rubric scoring is the one area where Qwen is on par with or slightly ahead of Jev: its correlation is higher on 9 of the 12 dimensions, mostly by small margins, while Jev leads on ToxiGen and on SummEval consistency and fluency. Gemma trails both on every dimension.
blocks.zh: 表5报告得分结果。 当标题描述文本本身的属性时,概率加权得分与人类的评级密切相关: ^ = 0.890\rho= 0.890 对于STS-B相似性, 0.851对于SST-5情绪, 0.841对于ToxiGen的攻击性评级. 因此,将SST-5作为普通尺度处理,比其57.9%的五进制精度所示的要好得多。 判断生成的文本比较难。 在SummEval上,Spearman的汇总级相关指数平均在四个维度上为0.554,最有利于一致性(0.639),最有利于流利度(0.495,其中Jev的评分也系统低于专家;MAE 1.77级). 在HelpSteer2上,关联范围从0.275(一致性)到0.558(动词),以及帮助性和正确性,这些属性需要验证一个响应的内容,最不与人类的评级(0.399和0.369)相关. 鲁布里克评分是Quen与Jev处于或略高于Jev的一个领域:在12维中的9维上,其相关性更高,大多是小差分,而Jev则领先于ToxiGen和SummEval一致性和流利度. Gemma在每一个维度上都有踪迹

blocks.en: 4.5 Multilinguality
blocks.zh: 4.5 多重性

blocks.en: Figure 5: Per-language accuracy on Belebele and SIB-200 for the 117 language varieties in both datasets (both built on FLORES-200 sentences). The dashed line is the diagonal.
blocks.zh: 图5:Belebele和SIB-200上对两个数据集117种语言品种的语精度(两者都建立在FLORES-200句的基础上). 虚线为对角线.

blocks.en: TypeSafe AI states that English is Jev’s primary language [ 6 ] . On Belebele, accuracy is 97.2% for English, and the median over 122 language varieties is 91.1%: 71 varieties reach at least 90%, while 10 fall below 70%, down to 37.4% for Nigerian Fulfulde. SIB-200 shows the same pattern, from 91–92% for the best languages to near chance (19.6%, with seven classes) for Santali in Ol Chiki script. On AfriXNLI, English (90.5%) and French (82.7%) are far ahead of the 16 African languages (33.8–70.3%). Figure 5 shows that performance per language is consistent across tasks (Spearman ρ = 0.69 \rho=0.69 between Belebele and SIB-200 accuracy). The degradation therefore reflects the language rather than the task. Among the languages in Figure 5 , the weakest are low-resource languages written in Latin script, so the script alone does not explain the gap; the very lowest SIB-200 results, however, occur for languages in scripts such as Ol Chiki, N’Ko and Tifinagh.
blocks.zh: TypeSafe AI表示英语是Jev的主要语言[6]. 在Belebele上,英语的精度为97.2%,122个语言品种的中位数为91.1%:71个品种达到至少90%,10个品种低于70%,尼日利亚富尔富尔德降至37.4%。 SIB-200显示同样的模式,从91-92%的最佳语言到几乎偶然(19.6%,有7个班)的桑塔利(Ol Chiki)脚本. 关于非洲荷兰语,英语(90.5%)和法语(82.7%)远远领先于16种非洲语言(33.8-70.3%)。 图5显示,每种语言的性能在各项任务之间是一致的(Spearman ^ = 0.69\rho= 0.69在Belebele和SIB-200精确度之间)。 因此,退化反映了语言而不是任务。 在图5中的语言中,最弱的是用拉丁字母写成的低资源语言,因此单是脚本并不能解释差距;然而,在脚本中,奥尔奇基,N'Ko和Tifinagh等语言的SIB-200结果却非常低.

blocks.en: 4.6 Documented weak spots and an unexplained MMLU result
blocks.zh: 4.6 记录的薄弱点和未解释的MMLU结果

blocks.en: Figure 6: Per-subject accuracy on C-Eval and MMLU, split into subjects that mostly require calculation (mathematics, physics, chemistry, statistics, accounting, formal logic) and all others.
blocks.zh: 图6 C-Eval 和 MMLU 上的每个主体精度,分为大多数需要计算(数学,物理,化学,统计,会计,形式逻辑)和所有其他科目.

blocks.en: TypeSafe AI lists arithmetic and numeric precision among Jev’s weaknesses [ 6 ] , and Jev produces no intermediate reasoning. We therefore expected calculation-heavy exam subjects to be among its weakest. On C-Eval this holds: calculation-heavy subjects have a lower median and a much wider spread ( Figure 6 ), with accuracies of 59.6% in high-school mathematics, 69.9% in advanced mathematics and 72.9% in probability and statistics. On MMLU, however, calculation-heavy subjects are, if anything, easier than the rest: 96.0% in abstract algebra, 96.0% in college mathematics, 94.8% in high-school mathematics and 99.0% in college physics. For a model that answers in a single step without generating a derivation, such accuracy on multi-step calculation questions is hard to reconcile with the vendor’s own description, and it raises the question of whether MMLU questions were seen during training [ 27 ] .
blocks.zh: TypeSafe AI在Jev的弱点中列出了算术和数值精度[6],Jev没有产生中间推理. 因此,我们预计计算繁重的考试科目是其最薄弱的科目之一。 在C-Eval方面,计算重的科目的中位数较低,分布范围更广(图6),高中数学成绩为59.6%,高级数学为69.9%,概率和统计为72.9%。 然而,在MMLU中,计算重的科目比其他科目容易:抽象代数为96.0%,大学数学为96.0%,高中数学为94.8%,大学物理为99.0%。 对于一个单步回答而不产生推论的模型,多步计算问题的这种准确性很难与供应商自己的描述相一致,它提出了在培训期间是否看到MMLU问题的问题[27]。

blocks.en: Two other explanations deserve mention. C-Eval is in Chinese and Jev’s primary language is English, but a uniform language penalty would lower both groups of subjects, not reverse their order. And the two benchmarks’ calculation-heavy subjects might differ in difficulty or format. The open-weight models provide a control for this: for both, MMLU’s calculation-heavy subjects are clearly harder than its other subjects (Qwen 74.7% vs. 83.0%, Gemma 54.6% vs. 69.8%; Table 6 ), as are C-Eval’s for all three models. Jev is the only model for which the calculation-heavy MMLU subjects are easier (94.3% vs. 91.3%).
blocks.zh: 另外两个解释值得一提。 C-Eval使用中文,Jev的主要语言为英语,但统一的语言惩罚会降低两类科目,而不是颠倒其顺序. 而这两个基准的计算繁重的主题在难度或格式上可能有所不同。 开放量级模型对此提供了一种控制:对这两种模型来说,MMLU的计算重度科目显然比其他科目更难(Quen 74.7%对83.0%,Gemma 54.6%对69.8%;表6),所有三种模型的C-Eval也是如此。 Jev是唯一一个计算重的MMLU科目比较容易的模型(94.3%,91.3%).

blocks.en: Table 6: Calculation-heavy vs. other subjects of MMLU and C-Eval for each model: accuracy with the original requests, and on the calculation-heavy subjects with the answer options rotated so that every option changes its letter, and with the question withheld (only the subject and the options are shown). Chance is 0.25.
blocks.zh: 表6:每个模型的计算重对 MMLU 和 C-Eval 的其他主体:与原始请求的准确性,与计算重的主体的答案选项相旋转,使每个选项更改其字母,并保留问题(仅显示主体和选项). 机会是0.25。

blocks.en:
To probe this, we re-ran the calculation-heavy subjects under two modified conditions ( Table 6 ). First, we rotated the answer options so that every option moves to a different letter. If Jev had memorized answer positions, accuracy would drop, but it stays at 94.3%. Second, we withheld the question and showed only the subject and the four options, a known test of whether answers can be inferred from the options alone [ 65 ] . On MMLU, accuracy then falls to 31.5%, close to chance and below the 37.3% reached on the C-Eval control. The open models behave the same way under both probes: rotating the options leaves their accuracy unchanged (Qwen 74.4%, Gemma 55.1%), and withholding the question drops it to 30.4–35.1% on MMLU and 30.7–39.9% on C-Eval. So neither memorized answer positions nor memorized option sets explain Jev’s MMLU results.
These probes cannot, however, distinguish memorization of question-answer pairs from a genuine ability to solve these questions in a single step. Perturbing the questions themselves, for example by changing the numbers in calculation problems, would be the decisive test and is left to future work. Taken together, the open models show that the calculation-heavy MMLU subjects are not intrinsically easy, and the probes rule out shallow memorization, which makes an effect specific to Jev and MMLU, such as training exposure to MMLU questions, the most plausible explanation; it cannot be confirmed without access to Jev’s training data. Until then, we treat the MMLU result, and by extension results on other long-established English benchmarks, with caution.
blocks.zh:
为了探究这一点,我们在两个修改的条件下重新排列计算重的主体(表6)。 首先,我们旋转了答案选项,使每个选项都移动到不同的字母. 如果Jev记住了回答位置,准确度会下降,但保持94.3%。 第二,我们搁置了这个问题,只展示了主题和四个选项,这是对是否能够仅从选项中推断答案的已知检验[65]. 在MMLU上,精度下降至31.5%,接近概率,低于C-Eval控制达到的37.3%。 开放型号在两种探针下都表现相同:旋转期权的精度保持不变(Quen 74.4%,Gemma 55.1%),而扣压问题则将其降低到MMLU的30.4–35.1%和C-Eval的30.7–39.9%. 因此,既未记住答案位置,也未记住选项集来解释Jev的MMLU结果.
然而,这些探测器无法区分对答对的记忆和在单步内解决这些问题的真正能力. 影响问题本身,例如改变计算问题的数目,将是决定性的考验,并留给今后的工作。 开放模型综合起来表明,计算重的MMLU科目在本质上并不容易,探测器排除了浅薄的记忆,这就对Jev和MMLU产生了特有影响,例如培训接触MMLU问题,这是最可信的解释;没有Jev的训练数据就无法确认。 在此之前,我们对待MMLU结果,并进而对其他早已确定的英语基准结果,谨慎处理.

blocks.en: The main evaluation consumed 217.9 million input tokens (630 per request on average, including all questions and option descriptions) and cost US$9.15 ( Table 7 ). The mean latency per request was 0.36 s, and throughput was limited by the rate limit rather than by the service. Multi-question requests cost little extra: a GoEmotions request with 28 Noul questions used 765 input tokens on average, compared with 559 for a single-question text-classification request. blocks.en: 5 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 限制

blocks.en: We evaluate one prompt template per dataset without tuning. Other phrasings could change results, in either direction, and some of our weaker results (e.g. AGB-DE, HelpSteer2) may partly reflect our wording. Our reference points are two open-weight models scored with the same prompts, which were written for Jev rather than tuned for these models, and scored in a single forward pass without thinking. Allowing these reasoning LLMs to reason before answering would likely raise their accuracy at a higher cost. Generative proprietary models, which would typically answer in text rather than through option probabilities, are not included, and comparisons with published results remain complicated by differing prompts, splits and in-context examples.
blocks.zh: 我们评价每个数据集一个快速模板,而不进行调试。 其他措辞可能会改变结果,无论是朝哪个方向,而我们的一些较弱的成果(例如AGB-DE,HelpSteer2)可能部分反映了我们的措辞. 我们的参考点是两个开量级的模型,用同样的提示来评分,这些提示是写给Jev的,而不是调制这些模型的,并且是在一个没有思考的单前传中评分. 允许这些推理法学硕士在回答之前讲道理,可能会提高准确性,费用更高。 通常用文字而不是通过选项概率来回答的基因专有模式不包括在内,与已公布结果的比较仍然因不同的提示、分裂和内容内的例子而复杂化。

blocks.en: Binary decisions use a fixed 0.5 threshold except in Table 4 , where thresholds are tuned on only 1,000 training examples per dataset. Our memorization probes cover only two shallow forms of memorization; they cannot detect memorized question-answer pairs. Several datasets are evaluated on validation rather than test splits because test labels are not public.
blocks.zh: 二进制决定使用一个固定的0.5阈值,但表4除外,其中每个数据集只有1,000个培训实例的阈值。 我们的记忆探测器只覆盖两种浅薄的记忆形式;它们无法检测记忆中的对答. 由于测试标签不公开,一些数据集在验证上被评价,而不是测试拆分.

blocks.en: We ran each request once and did not measure run-to-run variance. Latency was measured client-side and includes network time. The suite contains no relevance-judgment task, although Jev’s Score primitive is a natural fit for graded relevance labels. Finally, the results refer to jev-1.13.0 ; TypeSafe AI’s aliases ( jev-latest ) will likely move to newer versions.
blocks.zh: 我们运行了每个请求一次,没有测量运行中的差异。 纬度被测量客户端,包括网络时间. 虽然Jev的分数原始自然适合分级相关标签, 最后,结果提到jev-1.13.0;TypeSafe AI的别名(jev-latest)可能会转移到较新的版本.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: Jev delivers what its System One positioning promises on a wide range of short, well-scoped decisions: high zero-shot accuracy on sentiment, topic, intent and commonsense tasks, well-calibrated choice probabilities, confidence scores that support selective prediction, and very low cost. Against two open-weight LLMs scored on identical requests, Jev is ahead of Qwen3.8-27B on most datasets and of Gemma-4-E4B on all, and its calibration matches Qwen’s when averaged per dataset.
blocks.zh: Jev提供它的系统 一个定位承诺是一系列范围很广的简短决定:情绪、话题、意图和常识任务的高度零射精度、精心调整的选择概率、支持选择性预测的信心分数以及非常低的成本。 在两个相同请求的开放重量级LLMs中,Jev在大多数数据集上领先Quen3.8-27B,在Gemma-4-E4B上领先,其校准与Quen的每套数据集平均值相符。

blocks.en: Our evaluation of 37 datasets and 346,009 requests also shows its limits. Performance drops sharply for low-resource languages, fine-grained or noisy label sets, legal judgments and rubric-based assessment of generated text. Binary probabilities need application-specific thresholds, especially when many labels are queried at once, and thresholds tuned on a small training sample recover much of the resulting gap. The unexpectedly strong results on MMLU mathematics, which neither open model shows, are not explained by memorized answer positions or option artifacts. We release 2 2 2 github.com/AppliedMachineLearning-Lab/jev-benchmarking the suite, the harness and all raw responses so that every number can be recomputed and other typed decision models, as well as generative LLMs, can be compared on identical requests.
blocks.zh: 我们对37个数据集和346 009个请求的评价也显示了其局限性。 低资源语言、精细或吵闹的标签集、法律判决和对生成文本的按主题进行的评估的性能急剧下降。 二进制概率需要针对应用程序的阈值,特别是当许多标签同时被问及时,而根据小型培训样本调整的阈值恢复了由此产生的大部分差距。 MMLU数学上的出乎意料的强效结果,既不是开放模型显示的,也没有用记住的答案位置或选项文物来解释. 我们发布了2 2 github.com/AppliedMachineLearning-Lab/jev-基准,对套件、吊带和所有原始反应进行标记,以便每个数字可以重算,其他打字决定模型,以及基因LLMs可以根据相同的请求进行比较。
